entities.summary: Marcus Anthony Lemonis is an American businessman, TV personality, and entrepreneur. He is the co-owner of Camping World and serves as the executive chairman of Bed Bath & Beyond. Additionally, he is the star of The Profit, a CNBC reality show about saving small businesses. He is also the co-owner of Marcus/Glass Entertainment, which owns Let's Make a Deal. Currently he stars in the Fox reality series, The Fixer.
